description: Persona smoke expectations for 'sonic' (Rick's PR #108 second review: moved out of shared C# -- tests/conformance/tests/Conformance.Tests/PersonaSmokeTests.cs -- so no brand-specific literal lives there; a data-only pack PR adds only this file). Loaded by PersonaSmokeExpectations.For(personaId). Every field must be sourced from this SAME persona's own pack files, never invented: greetingSubstring from personas/sonic/prompts/greeting.yaml, and searchableOwnItem/orderableItemName/orderableItemSize/orderableItemPrice from personas/sonic/menu/menuItems.json (the size/price pair must match that file's entry exactly, or the add-to-order smoke step fails). orderableItemName should name an item that is NOT happyHourDiscounted:true in its pack, since PersonaSmokeTests.cs asserts the charged price equals this exact menu price and the smoke fixtures run on the real wall clock (not a FixedClock), so a happy-hour-eligible item's price could vary depending on when the suite runs. Refs #127: happyHour (eligibleItem/size/menuPrice, ineligibleItem/ineligibleSize/ineligibleMenuPrice, all from this SAME pack's own menu/menuItems.json) is loaded by RealPackHappyHourConformanceTests.cs's PersonaHappyHourSmokeExpectations.For(personaId, isEnabled) -- eligibleItem must have happyHourDiscounted:true, ineligibleItem must not.
greetingSubstring: Welcome to Sonic Drive-In! What can I get started for you today?
